specification.title: A migration whose reversal deletes its marker
steps: Runner A applies { m1 }. m1 inserts marker m1.
Revert with the framework's default selection. m1's reversal deletes marker m1.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the revert has returned and the reapply has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: If a revert reports a migration as reverted, its history entry is absent and its marker is absent.

execution.description: Connection::transaction(Closure) on one Capsule connection. Nested transaction() is a savepoint named transN. Eloquent creates write the markers. DatabaseTransactionsManager is not set. PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT is false. There is no pool.

configuration.nested: savepoint transN on the same connection
configuration.transactions_manager: not set; Capsule does not install DatabaseTransactionsManager
configuration.pool: none; one connection on the Capsule manager
configuration.isolation: connection config isolation_level, applied by PostgresConnector when set; transaction() takes no isolation argument
configuration.command_tag: not read; PDO::commit() does not expose one

execution.form: Migrator::run() and Migrator::rollback() on the Capsule connection, history table migrations. The migration file is generated for the case.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: A reported revert says the migration's effects are gone. The next apply is what shows that history and the database agree: the migration runs again.

api_outcome.contract: Laravel 13.38.0 Migrator::run() executes pending files and Migrator::rollback() reverts the last batch (Migrations/Migrator.php). runMigration wraps up() or down() in Connection::transaction() when the grammar supports schema transactions and withinTransaction is true. repository->log() and repository->delete() run after that transaction. There is no advisory lock. illuminate/filesystem is the package the migrator typehints for reading migration files.
